Our school, our crest

Academics

From JSS 1 to SSS 3

A structured journey through junior and senior secondary school.

Junior Secondary

JSS 1 – JSS 3. A strong foundation in language, mathematics, science, civic values and practical skills.

Senior Secondary

SSS 1 – SSS 3. Focused preparation across subject areas, guided by qualified teachers.

Character & Discipline

Uniform, punctuality and respect are part of the learning culture at PMC.
